title: Ibrance scientific exchange essentials
subtitle: Evidence interpretation for Medical Science Liaisons

slides.title: Ibrance scientific exchange essentials
content: Connect CDK4/6 biology to the labeled setting
Interpret PALOMA-2 efficacy with its limitations
Respond to dosing and safety questions from current evidence

slides.title: CDK4/6 inhibition interrupts the G1-to-S checkpoint
slides.purpose: Explain the mechanism at a scientific-exchange level
content: In ER-positive breast cancer cell lines, this blocks progression from G1 into S phase
Keep preclinical mechanism distinct from clinical outcome claims

slides.title: PALOMA-2 supports the first-line combination evidence story
slides.purpose: Connect trial evidence to the approved disease setting
content: Randomized evidence evaluated Ibrance plus letrozole against placebo plus letrozole
Investigator-assessed median PFS was 24.8 versus 14.5 months
Discuss population, comparator, and endpoint before quoting the result

slides.title: PFS improved, while final OS was not statistically significant
slides.purpose: Model balanced interpretation of multiple endpoints
content: Lead with the endpoint and analysis being discussed
Do not translate the PFS result into an unsupported survival claim
State the prespecified final OS result alongside the efficacy narrative

slides.title: Label-based responses pair the 28-day schedule with monitoring
content: Starting dose: 125 mg once daily for 21 days, then 7 days off
CBC before treatment, at each cycle start, and Day 15 of Cycles 1 and 2
Interrupt and evaluate immediately if ILD or pneumonitis is suspected

slides.title: Strong scientific exchange separates evidence from interpretation
content: Clarify the HCP's question and clinical context
Answer with the closest direct evidence and its limitations
Distinguish label facts, study findings, and interpretation
Escalate when the available evidence does not answer the question
